assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: production walking NPC sprite sheet for Magikitos, transparent PNG.
Image 1 is the exact character identity: Avelino, old kind forest wizard, green floppy pointed hat with wooden wheel brooch, white beard, mustard tunic, teal cloak with simple gold trim, brown boots, wooden lantern staff held in HIS RIGHT hand (image-left in front view). Preserve this identity.
Image 2 is ONLY the exact camera and sheet layout reference. Replace the girl with Avelino. Match the slightly elevated top-down game camera of image 2, not a frontal portrait camera.
Output a precise 8 COLUMN x 4 ROW sprite sheet, 2048x1024 canvas, equal 256x256 cells, 32 full-body sprites. Column headings left to right: FRONT/down, front-right/down-right, RIGHT profile, back-right/up-right, BACK/up, back-left/up-left, LEFT profile, front-left/down-left. Each column ALWAYS keeps its direction.
Rows: row 1 relaxed standing neutral, row 2 left foot forward walking contact, row 3 passing pose feet together, row 4 right foot forward walking contact. Slow natural short walking steps with staff as walking stick. The opposite leg MUST be leading in rows 2 and 4. Both boots readable.
Critical animation registration: EXACT SAME body height and proportions in ALL 32 cells, fixed head size and torso length, hat tip at relative y=22, planted sole baseline y=236. Pelvis centered at x=128 in EVERY cell, leave generous transparent margins. Keep the head and hat steady between rows; movement is legs and arms, slight natural cloak motion ONLY. No zoom changes, shrinking, stretching, morphing or bobbing. His staff stays on the same anatomical side in all headings, no mirrored hand switching. No missing poses, no cell overlaps, no labels, borders, letters, ground shadows or decorative objects. Genuine transparent alpha behind and between poses. Cozy detailed crisp pixel-art raster, earthy palette, readable at 48px tall like the existing game NPCs.
assets.paddingEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this 8-column x 4-row Avelino sprite sheet for safe production cutting.
KEEP all 32 character poses, their directions, artwork, palette, identity and walking phases exactly as drawn. Change only cell spacing/padding: reduce EVERY character by the SAME uniform factor to 78% of its present size, keep centered in its original cell, and place all planted boot soles on the SAME relative baseline at 90% of each cell's height. All heads must remain the same physical size across rows. Do not stretch any dimension independently.
Output canvas 2048x1024, 8x4 exact equal 256x256 cells. Each sprite must have at least 20 pixels of genuine transparent empty margin on ALL sides, including hat and boots. NO part of any sprite can cross into the next cell; rows need large clear transparent gutters. Keep full staff/boots/hat, no clipped pixels, no red fringes. No labels, grids, borders, background or shadows. Actual transparent PNG.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: Magikitos watermill timber bearing transparent game sprite.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve its elevated three-quarter camera, entire upper axle/bearing assembly, warm oak and dark iron style, lighting, canvas placement and dimensions.
Change ONLY the lower support construction. REMOVE ALL of the horizontal bottom/base rails joining the feet, including the diagonal-looking rails at the very bottom. There must be NO lower perimeter platform, NO feet pads, NO base frame sitting on the surface. Keep the upper and middle diagonal bracing for strength, but end these braces above the lower quarter of the legs. Continue the THREE individual wooden posts downward as long isolated piles, extending all the way to near the bottom of the canvas, where they can sink individually into the river bed in-game. The lowest quarter must consist of THREE SEPARATE posts with clear transparent spaces between them, NOT connected by any beams or metal strips. Damp dark brown wood at the lowest ends, no bulbous feet. Their ends will be hidden underwater by the game renderer.
The hub and upper cap must stay at exactly their original canvas coordinates and same size so it still meets the waterwheel. No wheel, house, water, shore, background, cast shadow or extra objects; genuine transparent alpha. Crisp textured pixel-art same as original.
